title: SUGHRA NE LIKHA BABA KAB LAOTKE AAOGE DUSHWAAR HUWA JEENA KAB LAOTKE AAOGE
body:
Roothi hai khushi Mujhse har lamha naya Gham hai
Dhadkan ki sadaao'n me tanhaai ka Maatam hai
Bhayya Ali Akbar ki furqat me ye aalam hai
Har Saans hai ek bhaala kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya jaaniye aate hain kyun mujhko ye andeshe
Manzar nazar aate hain jalte huwe Qaimo'n ke
Reh reh ke na jaane kyun girti hai rida Sar se
Kya haal hai Phupiyo'n ka kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehta hai tasawur me Chehra Ali Akbar ka
Phirta hai nigaho'n me Jhoola Ali Asghar ka
Allah Muhafiz hai ab Mere bhare Ghar ka
Ghabrata hai Dil Mera kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Aafat ke musibat ke ghurbat ke manazir hain
Ghere huwe har lamha furgat ke manazir hain
Abtak bhi nigaho'n me rukhsat ke manazir hain
Yaad aata hai Ghar sara kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Kal Aun-o Muhammad the aur Akbar-o Asghar the
Qasim tha Sakina thi Abbas-e Dilawar the
Saamaan Suku'n ke sab jis ghar me mayassar the
Us Ghar me hai sannata kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhayya Ali Akbar ka jab byaah racha hoga
Soncha na Kisi ne bhi hai door bahut Sughra
Hasrat hai ke dekhu'n Main Bhai ko banhe Dulha
Koondhi hu'n yaha'n Sehra kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab dekhti hu'n paani aansu'n nikal aate hain
Waswaas Mere dil ko har aan rulate hain
Kya pyaas ki eeza bhi Ghar waale uthate hain
Hai khushk Gala Mera kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyun jaane mujhe aksar aata hai khayaal aisa
Yu'n lagta hai jaise ke beparda hai sab kunba
Allah rakhe Parda Zehra ke Gharaane ka
Dil kampta hai Mera kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Shashmaha MeraBhai yaad aata hai reh reh kar
Kya ghutniyo'n Chalta hai ab Mera Ali Asghar
Ho pyaar Mera Baba Masoom ki aankhon par
Daali hu'n Main gehwaara kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya yaas hai aye Razvi pohncha hai khate Sughra
Reti pa rakha Sheh ne Laasha Ali Asghar ka
Rone lage Beti ka Khat padke Shahe Waala
Khat me yehi likhatha kab laotke Aaoge
<<MINI>>
Sughra ne likha Baba kab laotke Aaoge
author: Alamdar Razvi
